ðŸ”¬ Overview

MLT (Medical Lab Technology) is a vocational course in TS Intermediate that prepares students for careers in medical diagnostics, laboratory science, and healthcare support. It combines theory and hands-on training in laboratory techniques, equipment, and safety.

MLT students gain practical skills for immediate employment or further studies in paramedical and allied health sciences.

ðŸ“š Subjects (Telangana Vocational MLT)

In the Medical Lab Technician (MLT) vocational stream under TSBIE (Telangana State Board of Intermediate Education), students study both theory and practical subjects over 2 years:

  • Medical Laboratory Techniques â€“ Fundamentals of lab procedures, ethics, and lab safety.
  • Clinical Biochemistry â€“ Testing blood glucose, cholesterol, liver/kidney function, etc.
  • Clinical Microbiology â€“ Study of bacteria, viruses, fungi, parasites, and specimen processing.
  • Hematology & Blood Banking â€“ Blood testing, grouping, transfusion compatibility.
  • General Foundation Course (GFC) â€“ Communication skills, computer basics, health awareness.
  • Practical Training & Internship â€“ Hands-on lab experience in hospitals/labs.
Lab Techniques Biochemistry Microbiology Hematology GFC Internship
